eval.title: META STOCK ANALYSIS FOR 2024

call.headline_quote: in my eyes Facebook is simply meta too risky now

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: now the p ratio is 31 and the market cap is 885 billion

what_is_priced_in.quote: now the p ratio is 31 and the market cap is 885 billion for me I told you to buy here but for me now it is simply too expensive

reasons.claim: At a P/E of 31 the stock is simply too expensive versus when it was cheap at a P/E around 10.
reasons.quote: at the p ratio of 10 I was saying you are getting that for free that bet at a p ratio of 30 you are risking too much on a bet

data_check.gap_note: he says 31, as-of 41.2212 (FY2022); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: 30 billion a year poured into Reality Labs is too big a bet for shareholders to be forced to take at this valuation, especially since its revenue is shrinking not gaining traction.
reasons.quote: they are investing 30 billion per year in the reality Labs revenue and everything and that is not gaining traction actually it's going lower and lower

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: reality labs investment

reasons.claim: Cutting expenses to please Wall Street and push net income higher now sets up the normal Facebook cycle of a future scandal from underinvestment.
reasons.quote: as they cut on expenses you can expect a scandal going forward and then that's the normal cycle of Facebook cutting expenses lowering Investments delaying investment in Ai and the metaverse

reasons.claim: Facebook's implausible 4 billion monthly active people figure shows the company is overstating growth to please Wall Street.
reasons.quote: every person out there that has an internet connection is using Facebook okay double accounts but they say they have complex techniques algorithms and machine learning models

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: monthly active people

reasons.claim: Heavy buybacks push the stock higher but 26-30 billion is not enough relative to an 800 billion market cap to justify the risk taken.
reasons.quote: 30 billion on market cap of 800 billion is significant but in my eyes Facebook is simply meta too risky now
